changelog: Trunk attribution now evaluates every shared-IP candidate by observed direction, IP specificity, longest dialed-number prefix and an optional bounded priority.
CSV, JSON and Asterisk imports show a no-write preflight with shared IPs, ambiguous rules and entries without an IP before an administrator applies the catalog.
changelog_es: Shared-IP trunk attribution now evaluates every candidate by observed direction, IP specificity, longest dialed-number prefix and an optional bounded priority.
CSV, JSON and Asterisk imports now provide a no-write conflict preflight before the administrator applies the catalog.
Monitoring can switch between trunks active in the current window and all configured trunks.
